demo.title: guard-before-pay.sh
demo.code:
TARGET='https://merchant.example/api'
GUARD='https://agentresolver.vercel.app/api/payment-guard'

# Use an x402-capable caller-owned client to pay the separate $0.001 Guard fee.
# Require decision=eligible before separately authorizing the merchant payment.
printf '%s?url=%s&method=GET&maxPriceUsd=0.05\n' "$GUARD" "$TARGET"

setup: Install the AgentResolver Payment Guard skill.
Use a caller-owned x402-capable wallet/client for the separate Guard fee.
Keep merchant spending authorization and local wallet policy separate from Guard eligibility.
